messages:
alice.m: Heads up — after the 2.7.1 SDK push this morning we're seeing NPEs/OOMs on hosted eu-west for quant-llama3x when seq > 8k. ~1.2% error rate on serving traffic.
ben_p: Yikes. Cluster/log sample? Is it kvcache-related?
alice.m: Stack traces point to kv_restore. Example log: ```ERROR kv_restore.cpp:213 NPE: missing metadata for shard 42``` Observed on ~30k requests.
deploy-bot: Auto-pin suggestion: pin SDK -> 2.7.0 in region=eu-west. Reason: regressions touching kvcache restore. Command hint: `/pin apply --scope region=eu-west --package sdk=2.7.0`
carla_ops: I prefer a targeted SDK rollback in eu-west until we have a hotfix. Avoid pinning runtime — runtime appears unaffected.
dave_rt: Confirmed from runtime side: runtime/v3.2 shows no regressions. Root cause looks like SDK buffer handling when quant flag `q4hf=true` + longseq. Draft fix here: https://github.com/redwood/sdk/commit/abcd123 (WIP).
ben_p: What's the rollback blast radius? Any config drift we should watch for?
carla_ops: Rollback will be staged (canary -> 100%). Deploybot supports staged revert by service tag. Warm-up spike possible (~30s on some hosts).
alice.m: Plan: (1) apply SDK pin to 2.7.0 scoped to eu-west now (2) canary 5% for 15m, if error_rate < 0.2% expand to 100% in 30m (3) if not, escalate to full rollback and notify CSE/CS.
deploy-bot: Command queued: `/deploy rollback sdk 2.7.0 --scope eu-west --staged 5%:15m,100%:30m`
ops-runbook: Runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/sdks/2.7.1-regressions Checklist:
1) pin SDK to 2.7.0 (region=eu-west)
2) run `/obs query error_rate by model,region`
3) alert CSE if >1% after staging
(Will post monitoring dashboards in #eng-runtime)
dave_rt: Hotfix note: current branch fails mac-lint, adding tests now. ETA for 2.7.2 build ~2h. If rollback looks clean we'll cut 2.7.2 with the kvcache guard.
ben_p: Good. Also let's surface a per-model quant-flag error metric in console. @carla_ops can you add an alert?
carla_ops: On it — created alert `sdk.quant_error_rate_eu_west` threshold 0.5%.
alice.m: :thumbsup: Kicking off pin now.
deploy-bot: Pin applied: SDK=2.7.0 region=eu-west. Request ID: 98765. Monitoring channels: #eng-runtime #eng-oncall
ben_p: Canary (5%) looks promising — error rate down to 0.03% on sampled traffic. Latency stable.
dave_rt: Nice. Proceed with expansion per plan.
alice.m: Expanding to 100% now.
deploy-bot: Rollback completed: SDK=2.7.0 region=eu-west 100%. No rollback artifacts.
carla_ops: Closing loop — customer-facing incident page drafted, internal postmortem TBD. Note for docs: do not enable `q4hf` by default in SDK until 2.7.2 lands.
alice.m: Thanks all. I'll file the PR for release notes and update the compatibility matrix (SDK x quant flags x models).
ben_p: Also adding a short note to deploybot pinlist docs that this pin was region-scoped and timeboxed.
alice.m: :white_check_mark: Done. Thread resolved.
